units.zh: 樗里子者，名疾，秦惠王之弟也，與惠王異母。
units.en: Shu Lizi, whose given name was Ji, was the younger half-brother of King Hui of Qin.
units.literal: Shu Lizi, whose name was Ji, was King Hui of Qin's younger half-brother.

units.zh: 母，韓女也。
units.en: His mother was a woman from Han.
units.literal: His mother was a woman from Han.

units.zh: 樗里子滑稽多智，秦人號曰「智囊」。
units.en: Shu Lizi was witty and exceedingly clever. The people of Qin dubbed him the 'Wisdom Satchel.'
units.literal: Shu Lizi was witty and highly intelligent. The people of Qin called him the "Wisdom Bag."

units.zh: 秦惠王八年，爵樗里子右更，使將而伐曲沃，盡出其人，取其城，地入秦。
units.en: In the eighth year of King Hui of Qin, he granted Shu Lizi the rank of Right Geng and dispatched him as general to attack Quwo. They drove out all its inhabitants, seized the city, and the territory fell under Qin's control.
units.literal: In the eighth year of King Hui of Qin, he granted Shu Lizi the rank of Right Geng and sent him as general to attack Quwo. They expelled all its inhabitants, captured the city, and the territory came under Qin control.

units.zh: 秦惠王二十五年，使樗里子為將伐趙，虜趙將軍莊豹，拔藺。
units.en: In the twenty-fifth year of King Hui of Qin, he dispatched Shu Lizi as general to attack Zhao. They captured the Zhao general Zhuang Bao and seized the city of Lin.
units.literal: In the twenty-fifth year of King Hui of Qin, he sent Shu Lizi as general to attack Zhao. They captured the Zhao general Zhuang Bao and took the city of Lin.

units.zh: 明年，助魏章攻楚，敗楚將屈丐，取漢中地。
units.en: The following year, he aided Wei Zhang in attacking Chu, defeated the Chu general Qu Gai, and seized the territory of Hanzhong.
units.literal: The next year, he assisted Wei Zhang in attacking Chu, defeated the Chu general Qu Gai, and took the territory of Hanzhong.

units.zh: 秦封樗里子，號為嚴君。
units.en: Qin enfeoffed Shu Lizi and bestowed upon him the title Lord Yan.
units.literal: Qin enfeoffed Shu Lizi and gave him the title Lord Yan.

units.zh: 秦惠王卒，太子武王立，逐張儀、魏章，而以樗里子、甘茂為左右丞相。
units.en: When King Hui of Qin died, Crown Prince Wu ascended the throne as King Wu. He banished Zhang Yi and Wei Zhang, and appointed Shu Lizi and Gan Mao as left and right prime ministers.
units.literal: When King Hui of Qin died, Crown Prince Wu ascended the throne as King Wu. He expelled Zhang Yi and Wei Zhang, and appointed Shu Lizi and Gan Mao as left and right chancellors.

units.zh: 秦使甘茂攻韓，拔宜陽。
units.en: Qin dispatched Gan Mao to attack Han and seize Yiyang.
units.literal: Qin sent Gan Mao to attack Han and capture Yiyang.

units.zh: 使樗里子以車百乘入周。
units.en: Qin then sent Shu Lizi into Zhou with a hundred chariots.
units.literal: They sent Shu Lizi with a hundred chariots to enter Zhou.

units.zh: 周以卒迎之，意甚敬。
units.en: Zhou welcomed him with armed escort, showing utmost deference.
units.literal: Zhou welcomed him with troops, showing great respect.

units.zh: 楚王怒，讓周，以其重秦客。
units.en: The King of Chu grew furious and upbraided Zhou for favoring the Qin envoy.
units.literal: The King of Chu was angry and rebuked Zhou for favoring the Qin guest.

units.zh: 游騰為周說楚王曰：「知伯之伐仇猶，遺之廣車，因隨之以兵，仇猶遂亡。
units.en: You Teng advised the King of Chu on Zhou's behalf: "When Zhi Bo attacked Qiuyou, he sent them broad chariots, then followed up with troops, and Qiuyou was destroyed.
units.literal: You Teng for Zhou advised Chu Wang: Zhi Bo attack Qiu You, sent him broad chariot, because followed with troops, Qiu You then perished.

units.zh: 何則？
units.en: Why so?
units.literal: Why?

units.zh: 無備故也。
units.en: Because they were unprepared.
units.literal: Because they were unprepared.

units.zh: 齊桓公伐蔡，號曰誅楚，其實襲蔡。
units.en: When Duke Huan of Qi attacked Cai, he proclaimed it was to punish Chu, but in truth he ambushed Cai.
units.literal: When Duke Huan of Qi attacked Cai, he announced it was to punish Chu, but actually attacked Cai.

units.zh: 今秦，虎狼之國，使樗里子以車百乘入周，周以仇猶、蔡觀焉，故使長戟居前，彊弩在後，名曰衛疾，而實囚之。
units.en: Now Qin is a realm of tigers and wolves. If it sends Shu Lizi into Zhou with a hundred chariots, Zhou will remember what happened to Qiuyou and Cai. It will therefore station long lances before him and strong crossbows behind, calling it protection for Ji but in truth holding him prisoner.
units.literal: Now Qin is a land of tigers and wolves. If it sends Shu Lizi into Zhou with a hundred chariots, Zhou will judge the matter by what happened to Qiuyou and Cai. It will therefore place long halberds before him and strong crossbows behind, calling it protection for Ji but actually imprisoning him.

units.zh: 且夫周豈能無憂其社稷哉？
units.en: Moreover, how can Zhou not worry about its altars of soil and grain?
units.literal: Moreover, Zhou how can not worry its state altars?

units.zh: 恐一旦亡國以憂大王。」
units.en: I fear that one day Zhou will perish as a kingdom and cause anxiety for Your Majesty."
units.literal: I fear that one day Zhou will perish as a state and bring worry to Your Majesty."

units.zh: 楚王乃悅。
units.en: The King of Chu was then appeased.
units.literal: The King of Chu was then pleased.

units.zh: 秦武王卒，昭王立，樗里子又益尊重。
units.en: When King Wu of Qin died and King Zhao ascended the throne, Shu Lizi's esteem grew even greater.
units.literal: When King Wu of Qin died and King Zhao ascended the throne, Shu Lizi's status became even more honored.

units.zh: 昭王元年，樗里子將伐蒲。
units.en: In the first year of King Zhao, Shu Lizi commanded the assault on Pu.
units.literal: In the first year of King Zhao, Shu Lizi led an attack on Pu.

units.zh: 蒲守恐，請胡衍。
units.en: The governor of Pu grew fearful and summoned Huyan.
units.literal: The governor of Pu was afraid and sent for Huyan.

units.zh: 胡衍為蒲謂樗里子曰：「公之攻蒲，為秦乎？
units.en: Huyan spoke to Shu Lizi on behalf of Pu: "Is my lord attacking Pu for Qin's sake?
units.literal: Huyan for Pu told Shu Lizi: Jun attack Pu, for Qin?

units.zh: 為魏乎？
units.en: Or for Wei's?
units.literal: For Wei?

units.zh: 為魏則善矣，為秦則不為賴矣。
units.en: If it is for Wei's sake, that is well enough; if for Qin's sake, it will bring Wei no benefit.
units.literal: If for Wei, that would be good; if for Qin, it would not be beneficial.

units.zh: 夫衛之所以為衛者，以蒲也。
units.en: The reason Wey endures as Wey is because of Pu.
units.literal: The reason Wey exists as Wey is because of Pu.

units.zh: 今伐蒲入於魏，衛必折而從之。
units.en: If you now attack Pu and cede it to Wei, Wey will surely break and submit to Wei.
units.literal: If you now attack Pu and give it to Wei, Wey will surely submit to Wei.

units.zh: 魏亡西河之外而無以取者，兵弱也。
units.en: Wei forfeited the territories west of the Yellow River and cannot reclaim them because their military is feeble.
units.literal: Wei lost the lands west of the Yellow River and has no way to recover them because their army is weak.

units.zh: 今并衛於魏，魏必彊。
units.en: If you now annex Wey to Wei, Wei will surely grow powerful.
units.literal: If you now annex Wey to Wei, Wei will certainly become strong.

units.zh: 魏彊之日，西河之外必危矣。
units.en: When Wei grows mighty, the territories west of the Yellow River will surely be imperiled.
units.literal: When Wei becomes strong, the lands west of the Yellow River will certainly be in danger.

units.zh: 且秦王將觀公之事，害秦而利魏，王必罪公。」
units.en: Moreover, the King of Qin will scrutinize my lord's conduct. If it harms Qin and aids Wei, the king will surely condemn my lord."
units.literal: Moreover, the King of Qin will observe my lord's actions. If they harm Qin and benefit Wei, the king will certainly punish my lord."

units.zh: 樗里子曰：「柰何？」
units.en: Shu Lizi asked, "What should I do?"
units.literal: Shu Lizi said: What to do?

units.zh: 胡衍曰：「公釋蒲勿攻，臣試為公入言之，以德衛君。」
units.en: Huyan said, "My lord should release Pu and not attack it. I will try to go in and speak on your behalf, to win favor with the Lord of Wey."
units.literal: Huyan said: My lord should release Pu and not attack; I will try to go in and speak for my lord, so as to do a kindness to the Lord of Wey.

units.zh: 樗里子曰：「善。」
units.en: Shu Lizi replied, "Excellent."
units.literal: Shu Lizi said: Good.

units.zh: 胡衍入蒲，謂其守曰：「樗里子知蒲之病矣，其言曰必拔蒲。
units.en: Huyan entered Pu and told its governor, "Shu Lizi understands Pu's difficulties. He says he will certainly capture Pu.
units.literal: Huyan entered Pu, told its guard: Shu Lizi know Pu difficulty, his words certainly take Pu.

units.zh: 衍能令釋蒲勿攻。」
units.en: I can get him to abandon Pu and cease the attack."
units.literal: Yan can make him release Pu and not attack."

units.zh: 蒲守恐，因再拜曰：「願以請。」
units.en: The governor of Pu was afraid and bowed twice, saying, "I wish to make this request."
units.literal: Pu guard feared, because twice bow said: Wish with request.

units.zh: 因效金三百斤，曰：「秦兵茍退，請必言子於衛君，使子為南面。」
units.en: He presented three hundred jin of gold, saying, "If the Qin troops withdraw, I will certainly speak on your behalf to the Lord of Wey and make you face south as a ruler."
units.literal: Because presented gold three hundred jin, said: Qin troops if retreat, please certainly speak son to Wei jun, make son south face.

units.zh: 故胡衍受金於蒲以自貴於衛。
units.en: Therefore, Huyan accepted gold from Pu to elevate himself in Wey.
units.literal: Therefore, Huyan received gold from Pu to ennoble himself in Wei.

units.zh: 於是遂解蒲而去。
units.en: Thus, he raised the siege of Pu and withdrew.
units.literal: Thus, he lifted the siege of Pu and departed.

units.zh: 還擊皮氏，皮氏未降，又去。
units.en: He turned back and assaulted Pishi, but Pishi refused to yield, so he departed once more.
units.literal: He returned and attacked Pishi, but Pishi did not surrender, so he departed again.

units.zh: 昭王七年，樗里子卒，葬于渭南章臺之東。
units.en: In the seventh year of King Zhao, Shu Lizi passed away and was interred east of the Zhangtai Terrace south of the Wei River.
units.literal: In the seventh year of King Zhao, Shu Lizi died and was buried east of the Zhangtai Terrace south of the Wei River.

units.zh: 曰：「後百歲，是當有天子之宮夾我墓。」
units.en: He said, "A hundred years from now, the palaces of the Son of Heaven should flank my tomb."
units.literal: Said: After hundred years, this should have Son of Heaven palace flank my tomb.

units.zh: 樗里子疾室在於昭王廟西渭南陰鄉樗裏，故俗謂之樗里子。
units.en: Shu Lizi's residence was at Chuli in Yinxiang, south of the Wei River and west of King Zhao's temple; hence he was popularly called Shu Lizi.
units.literal: Shu Lizi's residence was west of the Zhao Wang Temple in the Yinxiang quarter south of the Wei River in Chuli, hence the common name for him.

units.zh: 至漢興，長樂宮在其東，未央宮在其西，武庫正直其墓。
units.en: When the Han dynasty emerged, the Changle Palace stood to its east, the Weiyang Palace to its west, and the imperial arsenal directly confronted his tomb.
units.literal: When the Han dynasty arose, the Changlegong Palace was to its east, the Weiyanggong Palace to its west, and the imperial armory directly faced his tomb.

units.zh: 秦人諺曰：「力則任鄙，智則樗裏。」
units.en: The Qin people had a proverb: "For strength, look to Ren Bi; for wisdom, look to Chuli."
units.literal: Qin proverb: Strength then Ren Bi, wisdom then Chu Li.

units.zh: 甘茂者，下蔡人也。
units.en: Gan Mao was a native of Xiaca.
units.literal: Gan Mao was a man of Xiaca.

units.zh: 事下蔡史舉先生，學百家之說。
units.en: He attended Master Shi Ju of Xiaca and mastered the teachings of the Hundred Schools.
units.literal: He served under Master Shi Ju of Xiaca and studied the doctrines of the Hundred Schools.

units.zh: 因張儀、樗里子而求見秦惠王。
units.en: Through Zhang Yi and Shu Lizi, he petitioned for an audience with King Hui of Qin.
units.literal: Through Zhang Yi and Shu Lizi, he sought an audience with King Hui of Qin.

units.zh: 王見而說之，使將，而佐魏章略定漢中地。
units.en: The king saw and delighted in him, appointed him general, and had him assist Wei Zhang in roughly pacifying the Han Zhong territory.
units.literal: Wang saw pleased him, made general, assisted Wei Zhang roughly pacified Han Zhong land.

units.zh: 惠王卒，武王立。
units.en: King Hui passed away, and King Wu ascended the throne.
units.literal: Hui Wang died, Wu Wang established.

units.zh: 張儀、魏章去，東之魏。
units.en: Zhang Yi and Wei Zhang departed and went east to Wei.
units.literal: Zhang Yi, Wei Zhang departed, east to Wei.

units.zh: 蜀侯煇、相壯反，秦使甘茂定蜀。
units.en: The Shu lord Hui and chancellor Zhuang rebelled. Qin dispatched Gan Mao to pacify Shu.
units.literal: Shu Hou Hui, chancellor Zhuang rebelled, Qin made Gan Mao pacify Shu.

units.zh: 還，而以甘茂為左丞相，以樗里子為右丞相。
units.en: Upon his return, they appointed Gan Mao as left prime minister and Shu Lizi as right prime minister.
units.literal: Returned, made Gan Mao left chancellor, Shu Lizi right chancellor.

units.zh: 秦武王三年，謂甘茂曰：「寡人欲容車通三川，以窺周室，而寡人死不朽矣。」
units.en: In the third year of King Wu of Qin, he addressed Gan Mao: "I want to open a chariot road through Sanchuan and look upon the Zhou court; then, though I die, my name will not decay."
units.literal: Qin Wu Wang three years, told Gan Mao: "I wish broad chariot pass San Chuan, spy Zhou house, I die not rotten."

units.zh: 甘茂曰：「請之魏，約以伐韓，而令向壽輔行。」
units.en: Gan Mao said, "I request to go to Wei, make a pact to attack Han, and have Xiang Shou accompany me."
units.literal: Gan Mao said: "Request Wei, pact attack Han, make Xiang Shou assist go."

units.zh: 甘茂至，謂向壽曰：「子歸，言之於王曰『魏聽臣矣，然願王勿伐』。
units.en: Gan Mao arrived and told Xiang Shou: "Return and speak to the king: 'Wei heeds my counsel, yet I wish Your Majesty not to attack.'
units.literal: Gan Mao arrived, told Xiang Shou: "You return, speak wang: 'Wei listen minister, yet wish wang not attack.'

units.zh: 事成，盡以為子功。」
units.en: When affairs succeed, I shall attribute all merit to you."
units.literal: Affairs complete, all as you merit."

units.zh: 向壽歸，以告王，王迎甘茂於息壤。
units.en: Xiang Shou returned and informed the king, who welcomed Gan Mao at Xirang.
units.literal: Xiang Shou returned, told wang, wang welcomed Gan Mao at Xi Rang.

units.zh: 甘茂至，王問其故。
units.en: Gan Mao arrived, and the king inquired about the reason.
units.literal: Gan Mao arrived, wang asked its reason.

units.zh: 對曰：「宜陽，大縣也，上黨、南陽積之久矣。
units.en: He replied: 'Yiyang is a major county. Shangdang and Nanyang have stored up resources there for a long time.
units.literal: Replied: "Yi Yang, big county, Shang Dang, Nan Yang store long.

units.zh: 名曰縣，其實郡也。
units.en: It is called a county in name, but in reality it is a commandery.
units.literal: Named county, actually commandery.

units.zh: 今王倍數險，行千里攻之，難。
units.en: Now Your Majesty would cross several dangerous passes and travel a thousand li to attack it; this is difficult.
units.literal: Now wang double several dangers, travel thousand li attack it, difficult.

units.zh: 昔曾參之處費，魯人有與曾參同姓名者殺人，人告其母曰『曾參殺人』，其母織自若也。
units.en: In former times, when Zeng Shen dwelt in Fei, a man from Lu with the same name as Zeng Shen committed murder. Someone told his mother, "Zeng Shen has killed a man," but his mother continued weaving undisturbed.
units.literal: Former Zeng Shen at Fei, Lu man with Zeng Shen same name kill person, person told his mother: Zeng Shen kill person, his mother weave as before.

units.zh: 頃之，一人又告之曰『曾參殺人』，其母尚織自若也。
units.en: Shortly after, another person told her, "Zeng Shen has killed a man," and his mother still continued weaving undisturbed.
units.literal: Shortly, one person again told: Zeng Shen kill person, his mother still weave as before.

units.zh: 頃又一人告之曰『曾參殺人』，其母投杼下機，踰墻而走。
units.en: Shortly after, yet another person told her, "Zeng Shen has killed a man," whereupon his mother threw down her shuttle, left her loom, climbed over the wall, and fled.
units.literal: Shortly again one person told: Zeng Shen kill person, his mother threw shuttle left loom, crossed wall fled.

units.zh: 夫以曾參之賢與其母信之也，三人疑之，其母懼焉。
units.en: Though Zeng Shen was worthy and fully trusted by his mother, once three men cast doubt on him, she grew fearful.
units.literal: Using Zeng Shen worthy with his mother trust him, three men doubt, his mother feared.

units.zh: 今臣之賢不若曾參，王之信臣又不如曾參之母信曾參也，疑臣者非特三人，臣恐大王之投杼也。
units.en: Now your minister's worthiness does not equal Zeng Shen's, and Your Majesty's trust in your minister does not equal Zeng Shen's mother's trust in Zeng Shen. Those who doubt your minister are not merely three men—I fear Your Majesty will throw down the shuttle.
units.literal: Now minister worthy not as Zeng Shen, wang trust minister again not as Zeng Shen mother trust Zeng Shen, doubt minister not only three men, minister fear wang throw shuttle.

units.zh: 始張儀西并巴蜀之地，北開西河之外，南取上庸，天下不以多張子而以賢先王。
units.en: At first Zhang Yi merged the lands of Bashu to the west, opened the territories north of the Yellow River, and seized Shangyong to the south. The world did not credit Master Zhang with the abundance of these gains but regarded the former king as worthy.
units.literal: At first Zhang Yi annexed the lands of Ba and Shu in the west, opened the territory beyond the Western River in the north, and took Shangyong in the south. The world did not credit Master Zhang with these abundant gains but instead praised the former king's worthiness.

units.zh: 魏文侯令樂羊將而攻中山，三年而拔之。
units.en: Marquis Wen of Wei commanded Yue Yang as general to attack Zhongshan, and after three years he captured it.
units.literal: Wei Wen Hou make Yue Yang general attack Zhong Shan, three years take it.

units.zh: 樂羊返而論功，文侯示之謗書一篋。
units.en: Yue Yang returned and sought reward for his merit. Marquis Wen showed him a casket filled with slanderous letters.
units.literal: When Yue Yang returned and requested reward for his merit, Marquis Wen showed him a box full of slanderous letters.

units.zh: 樂羊再拜稽首曰：『此非臣之功也，主君之力也。』
units.en: Yue Yang bowed twice and touched his head to the ground: "This is not my merit; it is my lord's strength."
units.literal: Yue Yang twice bow touched head: This not subject merit, jun effort.

units.zh: 今臣，羈旅之臣也。
units.en: Now your minister is a sojourning minister.
units.literal: Now minister, sojourner minister.

units.zh: 樗里子、公孫奭二人者挾韓而議之，王必聽之，是王欺魏王而臣受公仲侈之怨也。」
units.en: These two men, Shu Lizi and Gongsun Shi, will grasp Han's interests and discuss it with the king, who will certainly listen to them. This means Your Majesty deceives the King of Wei while your minister receives the resentment of Gong Zhongchi.'
units.literal: Shu Lizi and Gongsun Shi will argue the matter from Han's side, and the king will certainly listen to them. Thus the king will have deceived the King of Wei, while your minister will incur Gong Zhongchi's resentment."

units.zh: 王曰：「寡人不聽也，請與子盟。」
units.en: The king declared: 'I will not listen to them. Allow me to make a covenant with you.'
units.literal: Wang said: I not listen, please with you pact.

units.zh: 卒使丞相甘茂將兵伐宜陽。
units.en: In the end, they dispatched Prime Minister Gan Mao to lead troops and attack Yiyang.
units.literal: Finally made chancellor Gan Mao lead troops attack Yi Yang.

units.zh: 五月而不拔，樗里子、公孫奭果爭之。
units.en: After five months without capturing it, Shu Lizi and Gongsun Shi indeed argued against continuing.
units.literal: After five months without taking it, Shu Lizi and Gongsun Shi indeed argued against continuing.

units.zh: 武王召甘茂，欲罷兵。
units.en: King Wu summoned Gan Mao, desiring to withdraw the troops.
units.literal: Wu Wang summoned Gan Mao, wished stop troops.

units.zh: 甘茂曰：「息壤在彼。」
units.en: Gan Mao declared: 'Xirang is over there.'
units.literal: Gan Mao said: "Xi Rang at that."

units.zh: 王曰：「有之。」
units.en: The king replied: 'Indeed.'
units.literal: Wang said: "Have."

units.zh: 因大悉起兵，使甘茂擊之。
units.en: Therefore, he greatly mobilized all troops and dispatched Gan Mao to strike at it.
units.literal: Because greatly all raised troops, made Gan Mao strike it.

units.zh: 斬首六萬，遂拔宜陽。
units.en: They beheaded sixty thousand and then captured Yiyang.
units.literal: Beheaded sixty thousand, then took Yiyang.

units.zh: 韓襄王使公仲侈入謝，與秦平。
units.en: King Xiang of Han dispatched Gong Zhongchi to enter and apologize, making peace with Qin.
units.literal: Han Xiang Wang made Gong Zhong Chi enter thank, with Qin peace.

units.zh: 武王竟至周，而卒於周。
units.en: King Wu finally reached Zhou, but died in Zhou.
units.literal: Wu Wang finally to Zhou, died Zhou.

units.zh: 其弟立，為昭王。
units.en: His younger brother ascended the throne as King Zhao.
units.literal: His younger brother established, Zhao Wang.

units.zh: 王母宣太后，楚女也。
units.en: The king's mother was Empress Dowager Xuan, a woman from Chu.
units.literal: Wang mother Xuan Empress Dowager, Chu woman.

units.zh: 楚懷王怨前秦敗楚於丹陽而韓不救，乃以兵圍韓雍氏。
units.en: King Huai of Chu resented that Qin had previously defeated Chu at Danyang and Han had not come to their aid. Therefore, he deployed troops to surround Han's Yongshi.
units.literal: Chu Huai Wang resented former Qin defeat Chu Dan Yang Han not save, then with troops surround Han Yong Shi.

units.zh: 韓使公仲侈告急於秦。
units.en: Han dispatched Gong Zhongchi to urgently report the crisis to Qin.
units.literal: Han made Gong Zhong Chi report urgent Qin.

units.zh: 秦昭王新立，太后楚人，不肯救。
units.en: King Zhao of Qin had newly ascended the throne. The Empress Dowager was from Chu and refused to provide aid.
units.literal: Qin Zhao Wang new established, Empress Dowager Chu person, not willing save.

units.zh: 公仲因甘茂，茂為韓言於秦昭王曰：「公仲方有得秦救，故敢捍楚也。
units.en: Gong Zhong went through Gan Mao, who spoke on Han's behalf to King Zhao of Qin: 'Gong Zhong is counting on receiving Qin's aid, which is why he dares to resist Chu.
units.literal: Gong Zhong because Gan Mao, Mao for Han spoke Qin Zhao Wang: "Gong Zhong just have obtain Qin save, therefore dare resist Chu.

units.zh: 今雍氏圍，秦師不下殽，公仲且仰首而不朝，公叔且以國南合於楚。
units.en: Now Yongshi is besieged. If Qin troops do not descend from Xiao, Gong Zhong will raise his head in defiance and not attend court, while Gongshu will lead the state south to unite with Chu.
units.literal: Now Yong Shi surround, Qin troops not descend Xiao, Gong Zhong moreover raise head not court, Gongshu moreover with state south unite Chu.

units.zh: 楚、韓為一，魏氏不敢不聽，然則伐秦之形成矣。
units.en: If Chu and Han become one, the Wei clan will dare not refuse to heed them. Then the coalition to attack Qin will take form.
units.literal: Chu Han become one, Wei clan dare not not listen, then attack Qin form completed.

units.zh: 不識坐而待伐孰與伐人之利？」
units.en: Do you not know whether it is more advantageous to sit and await attack or to attack others?'
units.literal: Not know sit await attack compared attack person profit?"

units.zh: 秦王曰：「善。」
units.en: The King of Qin declared: 'Excellent.'
units.literal: Qin Wang said: "Good."

units.zh: 乃下師於殽以救韓。
units.en: Therefore, they dispatched troops down from Xiao to save Han.
units.literal: Then sent troops Xiao save Han.

units.zh: 楚兵去。
units.en: The Chu troops withdrew.
units.literal: Chu troops departed.

units.zh: 秦使向壽平宜陽，而使樗里子、甘茂伐魏皮氏。
units.en: Qin dispatched Xiang Shou to pacify Yiyang, while sending Shu Lizi and Gan Mao to attack Wei's Pishi.
units.literal: Qin made Xiang Shou pacify Yi Yang, made Shu Lizi, Gan Mao attack Wei Pi Shi.

units.zh: 向壽者，宣太后外族也，而與昭王少相長，故任用。
units.en: Xiang Shou was from Empress Dowager Xuan's extended family. He had grown up alongside King Zhao from childhood, which is why he was employed.
units.literal: Xiang Shou was a member of the Empress Dowager Xuan's extended family. He had grown up with King Zhao from childhood, which is why he was employed.

units.zh: 向壽如楚，楚聞秦之貴向壽，而厚事向壽。
units.en: Xiang Shou went to Chu. Chu, learning that Qin esteemed Xiang Shou, treated him with great generosity.
units.literal: Xiang Shou like Chu, Chu heard Qin noble Xiang Shou, thick served Xiang Shou.

units.zh: 向壽為秦守宜陽，將以伐韓。
units.en: Xiang Shou guarded Yiyang for Qin, preparing to attack Han.
units.literal: Xiang Shou for Qin guard Yi Yang, will attack Han.

units.zh: 韓公仲使蘇代謂向壽曰：「禽困覆車。
units.en: Han's Gong Zhong sent Su Dai to address Xiang Shou: 'A trapped bird overturns the cart.
units.literal: Han Gong Zhong made Su Dai tell Xiang Shou: "Bird trapped overturn cart.

units.zh: 公破韓，辱公仲，公仲收國復事秦，自以為必可以封。
units.en: If you defeat Han and humiliate Gong Zhong, Gong Zhong will rally the state to serve Qin once more, believing he will certainly be enfeoffed.
units.literal: Jun break Han, humiliate Gong Zhong, Gong Zhong collect state again serve Qin, self think certainly can enfeoff.

units.zh: 今公與楚解口地，封小令尹以杜陽。
units.en: Suppose my lord now cedes the land of Koudi to Chu and enfeoffs the Lesser Lingyin with Duyang.
units.literal: Now jun with Chu release Kou Di land, enfeoff small Ling Yin Du Yang.

units.zh: 秦楚合，復攻韓，韓必亡。
units.en: Qin and Chu will unite and attack Han once more—Han will certainly perish.
units.literal: Qin Chu unite, again attack Han, Han certainly perish.

units.zh: 韓亡，公仲且躬率其私徒以閼於秦。
units.en: When Han perishes, Gong Zhong will personally lead his private retainers to block Qin.
units.literal: Han perish, Gong Zhong moreover personally lead his private followers block Qin.

units.zh: 願公孰慮之也。」
units.en: I wish you to deliberate carefully on this.'
units.literal: Wish jun carefully consider."

units.zh: 向壽曰：「吾合秦楚非以當韓也，子為壽謁之公仲，曰秦韓之交可合也。」
units.en: Xiang Shou declared: 'I unite Qin and Chu not to oppose Han. For my sake, report to Gong Zhong that the alliance between Qin and Han can be restored.'
units.literal: Xiang Shou said: "I unite Qin Chu not to oppose Han, you for Shou report Gong Zhong, Qin Han alliance can unite."

units.zh: 蘇代對曰：「願有謁於公。
units.en: Su Dai replied: 'I wish to make a report to you.
units.literal: Su Dai replied: "Wish have report jun.

units.zh: 人曰貴其所以貴者貴。
units.en: People say that what makes nobility noble is nobility.
units.literal: People say noble what noble noble.

units.zh: 王之愛習公也，不如公孫奭；
units.en: The king's affection and familiarity with you is not as great as with Gongsun Shi;
units.literal: The king's affection and familiarity with my lord do not equal his affection for Gongsun Shi;

units.zh: 其智能公也，不如甘茂。
units.en: In intelligence and ability, my lord does not equal Gan Mao.
units.literal: His intelligence jun, not as Gan Mao.

units.zh: 今二人者皆不得親於秦事，而公獨與王主斷於國者何？
units.en: Now those two men are not allowed to participate in Qin affairs, yet my lord alone with the king decides matters of state—why is this?
units.literal: Now two men all not close Qin affairs, jun alone with wang main decide state, why?

units.zh: 彼有以失之也。
units.en: There is a reason they lost that intimacy.
units.literal: They have reason lose it.

units.zh: 公孫奭黨於韓，而甘茂黨於魏，故王不信也。
units.en: Gongsun Shi favors Han, while Gan Mao favors Wei—therefore the king does not trust them.
units.literal: Gongsun Shi favored Han, while Gan Mao favored Wei; therefore the king did not trust them.

units.zh: 今秦楚爭彊而公黨於楚，是與公孫奭、甘茂同道也，公何以異之？
units.en: Now Qin and Chu contend for supremacy, yet my lord favors Chu—this is the same path as Gongsun Shi and Gan Mao. How are you different from them?
units.literal: Now Qin and Chu contend for supremacy, yet my lord favors Chu. This follows the same course as Gongsun Shi and Gan Mao; how is my lord different from them?

units.zh: 人皆言楚之善變也，而公必亡之，是自為責也。
units.en: Everyone says that Chu is fickle, yet my lord is determined to rely on it; this brings blame upon yourself.
units.literal: People all say Chu good change, jun certainly perish it, this self make blame.

units.zh: 公不如與王謀其變也，善韓以備楚，如此則無患矣。
units.en: My lord should plan for change with the king, befriend Han to prepare against Chu—in this way there will be no calamity.
units.literal: Jun not as with wang plan its change, good Han prepare Chu, like this no calamity.

units.zh: 韓氏必先以國從公孫奭而後委國於甘茂。
units.en: Han will surely first submit the state to Gongsun Shi, then entrust it to Gan Mao.
units.literal: Han will certainly first commit the state to Gongsun Shi and afterward entrust it to Gan Mao.

units.zh: 韓，公之讎也。
units.en: Han is my lord's enemy.
units.literal: Han, jun enemy.

units.zh: 今公言善韓以備楚，是外舉不僻讎也。」
units.en: Now my lord speaks well of Han to prepare against Chu; abroad, this means recommending someone without avoiding your enemy.'
units.literal: Now jun speak good Han prepare Chu, this external raise not biased enemy."

units.zh: 向壽曰：「然，吾甚欲韓合。」
units.en: Xiang Shou declared: 'Indeed, I very much wish to unite with Han.'
units.literal: Xiang Shou said: "Correct, I very wish Han unite."

units.zh: 對曰：「甘茂許公仲以武遂，反宜陽之民，今公徒收之，甚難。」
units.en: He replied: 'Gan Mao promised Gong Zhong Wusui and the return of Yiyang's people. Now my lord alone seeks to collect it—this is very difficult.'
units.literal: Replied: "Gan Mao promised Gong Zhong Wu Sui, return Yi Yang people, now jun alone collect it, very difficult."

units.zh: 向壽曰：「然則奈何？
units.en: Xiang Shou asked: 'Then what is to be done?
units.literal: Xiang Shou said: "Then what?

units.zh: 武遂終不可得也？」
units.en: Can Wusui never be obtained?'
units.literal: Wu Sui finally cannot obtain?"

units.zh: 對曰：「公奚不以秦為韓求潁川於楚？
units.en: He replied: 'Why does my lord not seek Yingchuan from Chu for Han on Qin's behalf?
units.literal: Replied: "Jun why not with Qin for Han seek Ying Chuan Chu?

units.zh: 此韓之寄地也。
units.en: This is entrusted land for Han.
units.literal: This Han trust land.

units.zh: 公求而得之，是令行於楚而以其地德韓也。
units.en: If my lord seeks it and obtains it, your command has carried weight in Chu and you confer the land as a favor to Han.
units.literal: Jun seek obtain it, this make orders walk Chu with its land virtue Han.

units.zh: 公求而不得，是韓楚之怨不解而交走秦也。
units.en: If my lord seeks it but does not obtain it, the resentment between Han and Chu will remain unresolved, and both sides will hasten toward Qin.
units.literal: Jun seek not obtain, this Han Chu resentment not resolve alliance hasten Qin.

units.zh: 秦楚爭彊，而公徐過楚以收韓，此利於秦。」
units.en: As Qin and Chu contend for supremacy, my lord can leisurely pass through Chu to win Han—this benefits Qin.'
units.literal: Qin Chu contend strong, jun slowly pass Chu collect Han, this benefit Qin."

units.zh: 向壽曰：「柰何？」
units.en: Xiang Shou asked: 'How so?'
units.literal: Xiang Shou said: "What?"

units.zh: 對曰：「此善事也。
units.en: He replied: 'This is a good affair.
units.literal: Replied: "This good affair.

units.zh: 甘茂欲以魏取齊，公孫奭欲以韓取齊。
units.en: Gan Mao wishes to use Wei to take Qi, Gongsun Shi wishes to use Han to take Qi.
units.literal: Gan Mao wished to use Wei to take Qi, while Gongsun Shi wished to use Han to take Qi.

units.zh: 今公取宜陽以為功，收楚韓以安之，而誅齊魏之罪，是以公孫奭、甘茂無事也。」
units.en: Now my lord can take Yiyang as merit, win over Chu and Han to secure it, and punish Qi and Wei's crimes—this renders Gongsun Shi and Gan Mao without affairs.'
units.literal: Now my lord can take Yiyang as his achievement, win over Chu and Han to secure it, and punish the offenses of Qi and Wei. In this way Gongsun Shi and Gan Mao will have nothing to do."

units.zh: 甘茂竟言秦昭王，以武遂復歸之韓。
units.en: Gan Mao finally spoke to King Zhao of Qin and returned Wusui to Han.
units.literal: Gan Mao finally spoke Qin Zhao Wang, with Wu Sui return Han.

units.zh: 向壽、公孫奭爭之，不能得。
units.en: Xiang Shou and Gongsun Shi argued against it but could not prevail.
units.literal: Xiang Shou and Gongsun Shi argued against it but could not prevail.

units.zh: 向壽、公孫奭由此怨，讒甘茂。
units.en: Xiang Shou and Gongsun Shi therefore resented him and slandered Gan Mao.
units.literal: Xiang Shou and Gongsun Shi therefore became resentful and slandered Gan Mao.

units.zh: 茂懼，輟伐魏蒲阪，亡去。
units.en: Gan Mao grew fearful, abandoned the attack on Wei's Puban, and fled.
units.literal: Mao feared, stopped attack Wei Pu Ban, fled.

units.zh: 樗里子與魏講，罷兵。
units.en: Shu Lizi negotiated with Wei and withdrew the troops.
units.literal: Shu Lizi with Wei discussed, stopped troops.

units.zh: 甘茂之亡秦奔齊，逢蘇代。
units.en: When Gan Mao fled Qin and went to Qi, he encountered Su Dai.
units.literal: Gan Mao fled Qin go Qi, met Su Dai.

units.zh: 代為齊使於秦。
units.en: Su Dai was serving as Qi's envoy to Qin.
units.literal: Dai as Qi envoy Qin.

units.zh: 甘茂曰：「臣得罪於秦，懼而遯逃，無所容跡。
units.en: Gan Mao declared: 'Your subject has offended Qin. I fled in fear, with no place to hide my traces.
units.literal: Gan Mao said: "Subject get crime Qin, feared fled escape, no place hide trace.

units.zh: 臣聞貧人女與富人女會績，貧人女曰：『我無以買燭，而子之燭光幸有餘，子可分我餘光，無損子明而得一斯便焉。』
units.en: Your subject has heard that when a poor man's daughter and a rich man's daughter were spinning together, the poor girl said: "I have no means to buy a candle, but your candlelight fortunately has surplus. You can share your surplus light with me, harming not your brightness while I gain this convenience."
units.literal: Subject heard poor man daughter with rich man daughter meet spin, poor man daughter said: I no buy candle, your candle light fortunately have surplus, you can divide me surplus light, no harm your brightness obtain one convenience.

units.zh: 今臣困而君方使秦而當路矣。
units.en: Now your subject is in distress, while you are serving as envoy to Qin and control access along the road.
units.literal: Now subject distressed jun just envoy Qin control road.

units.zh: 茂之妻子在焉，願君以餘光振之。」
units.en: Gan Mao's wife and children are there. I wish you to use your surplus light to succor them.'
units.literal: Mao wife children there, wish jun with surplus light shake them."

units.zh: 蘇代許諾。
units.en: Su Dai consented.
units.literal: Su Dai permitted.

units.zh: 遂致使於秦。
units.en: He then completed his mission as envoy to Qin.
units.literal: Then completed envoy Qin.

units.zh: 已，因說秦王曰：「甘茂，非常士也。
units.en: Having done so, he then advised the King of Qin: 'Gan Mao is no ordinary scholar.
units.literal: Already, because advised Qin Wang: "Gan Mao, not common scholar.

units.zh: 其居於秦，累世重矣。
units.en: His position in Qin has been honored for generations.
units.literal: His dwell Qin, several generations heavy.

units.zh: 自殽塞及至鬼谷，其地形險易皆明知之。
units.en: From Xiao Pass to Guigu Valley, he clearly knows all the difficult and easy terrain.
units.literal: From Xiao Pass to Gui Gu, its land form danger easy all clearly know.

units.zh: 彼以齊約韓魏反以圖秦，非秦之利也。」
units.en: If he allies with Qi to make Han and Wei turn against Qin, it will not benefit Qin.'
units.literal: He with Qi pact Han Wei return plot Qin, not Qin profit."

units.zh: 秦王曰：「然則柰何？」
units.en: The King of Qin asked: 'Then what is to be done?'
units.literal: Qin Wang said: "Then what?"

units.zh: 蘇代曰：「王不若重其贄，厚其祿以迎之，使彼來則置之鬼谷，終身勿出。」
units.en: Su Dai declared: 'Your Majesty should increase his gifts, enrich his salary to welcome him, and when he comes, place him in Guigu Valley, never to emerge for life.'
units.literal: Su Dai said: "Wang not as heavy his gift, thick his salary welcome him, make he come then place Gui Gu, lifetime not out."

units.zh: 秦王曰：「善。」
units.en: The King of Qin declared: 'Excellent.'
units.literal: Qin Wang said: "Good."

units.zh: 即賜之上卿，以相印迎之於齊。
units.en: He immediately granted him the rank of upper minister and sent the prime minister's seal to welcome him from Qi.
units.literal: Immediately granted upper qing, with chancellor seal welcome at Qi.

units.zh: 甘茂不往。
units.en: Gan Mao did not go.
units.literal: Gan Mao not go.

units.zh: 蘇代謂齊湣王曰：「夫甘茂，賢人也。
units.en: Su Dai addressed King Min of Qi: 'Gan Mao is a worthy man.
units.literal: Su Dai told Qi Min Wang: "Gan Mao, worthy man.

units.zh: 今秦賜之上卿，以相印迎之。
units.en: Now Qin has granted him the rank of upper minister and sent the prime minister's seal to welcome him.
units.literal: Now Qin grant upper qing, with chancellor seal welcome him.

units.zh: 甘茂德王之賜，好為王臣，故辭而不往。
units.en: Gan Mao appreciates Your Majesty's favor and wishes to serve as your minister, therefore he declined and did not go.
units.literal: Gan Mao virtue wang grant, good be wang minister, therefore decline not go.

units.zh: 今王何以禮之？」
units.en: Now how should Your Majesty honor him?'
units.literal: Now wang how ritual him?"

units.zh: 齊王曰：「善。」
units.en: The King of Qi declared: 'Excellent.'
units.literal: Qi Wang said: "Good."

units.zh: 即位之上卿而處之。
units.en: He immediately appointed him upper minister and treated him accordingly.
units.literal: Immediately placed upper qing treat him.

units.zh: 秦因復甘茂之家以市於齊。
units.en: Qin therefore returned Gan Mao's family to bargain with Qi.
units.literal: Qin because again Gan Mao family to trade Qi.

units.zh: 齊使甘茂於楚，楚懷王新與秦合婚而驩。
units.en: Qi dispatched Gan Mao as envoy to Chu, where King Huai had newly allied with Qin through marriage and was on good terms.
units.literal: Qi made Gan Mao envoy Chu, Chu Huai Wang new with Qin unite marriage happy.

units.zh: 而秦聞甘茂在楚，使人謂楚王曰：「願送甘茂於秦。」
units.en: When Qin learned Gan Mao was in Chu, they sent someone to address the King of Chu: 'We wish you to send Gan Mao to Qin.'
units.literal: Qin heard Gan Mao Chu, made person tell Chu Wang: "Wish send Gan Mao Qin."

units.zh: 楚王問於范蜎曰：「寡人欲置相於秦，孰可？」
units.en: The King of Chu asked Fan Quan: 'I wish to place a prime minister in Qin—who would be suitable?'
units.literal: Chu Wang asked Fan Quan: "I wish place chancellor Qin, who suitable?"

units.zh: 對曰：「臣不足以識之。」
units.en: He replied: 'Your subject is not qualified to know such matters.'
units.literal: Replied: "Subject not enough know."

units.zh: 楚王曰：「寡人欲相甘茂，可乎？」
units.en: The King of Chu asked: 'I wish to make Gan Mao prime minister—is this acceptable?'
units.literal: Chu Wang said: "I wish chancellor Gan Mao, acceptable?"

units.zh: 對曰：「不可。
units.en: He replied: 'It is not acceptable.
units.literal: Replied: "Not acceptable.

units.zh: 夫史舉，下蔡之監門也，大不為事君，小不為家室，以茍賤不廉聞於世，甘茂事之順焉。
units.en: Shi Ju was a gatekeeper of Xiaca. On the great scale he did not serve his lord; on the small scale he did not maintain his household, and he was known throughout the world as lowly and unprincipled. Yet Gan Mao served him compliantly.
units.literal: Shi Ju, Xia Cai gate guard, greatly not serve jun, small not family room, with cheap not clean known world, Gan Mao serve him comply.

units.zh: 故惠王之明，武王之察，張儀之辯，而甘茂事之，取十官而無罪。
units.en: Thus, though King Hui was discerning, King Wu perceptive, and Zhang Yi eloquent, Gan Mao served them all, holding ten offices without incurring blame.
units.literal: Therefore, Hui Wang clear, Wu Wang examine, Zhang Yi eloquence, Gan Mao serve them, take ten offices no crime.

units.zh: 茂誠賢者也，然不可相於秦。
units.en: Gan Mao is truly a worthy man, yet he cannot serve as prime minister in Qin.
units.literal: Mao truly worthy, yet not chancellor Qin.

units.zh: 夫秦之有賢相，非楚國之利也。
units.en: For Qin to have a worthy prime minister is not advantageous for the state of Chu.
units.literal: Qin have worthy chancellor, not Chu state profit.

units.zh: 且王前嘗用召滑於越，而內行章義之難，越國亂，故楚南塞厲門而郡江東。
units.en: Moreover, Your Majesty once employed Zhao Hua in Yue, where he secretly fomented turmoil while outwardly displaying benevolence and righteousness. Yue fell into chaos, allowing Chu to close the Limen route to the south and establish commanderies in Jiangdong.
units.literal: Moreover, the king previously employed Zhao Hua in Yue, where he secretly caused disorder while outwardly displaying benevolence and righteousness. Yue fell into chaos; therefore Chu closed the Limen route to the south and established commanderies in Jiangdong.

units.zh: 計王之功所以能如此者，越國亂而楚治也。
units.en: The reason Your Majesty's achievements could be so great was that Yue was in chaos while Chu was well governed.
units.literal: Calculate wang merit so can like this, Yue state chaotic Chu govern.

units.zh: 今王知用諸越而忘用諸秦，臣以王為鉅過矣。
units.en: Now Your Majesty knows how to use Yue but forgets how to use Qin—your subject considers this a grave error.
units.literal: Now wang know use Yue forget use Qin, subject think wang great error.

units.zh: 然則王若欲置相於秦，則莫若向壽者可。
units.en: Therefore, if Your Majesty wishes to place a prime minister in Qin, none is better than Xiang Shou.
units.literal: Then wang if wish place chancellor Qin, then none better Xiang Shou suitable.

units.zh: 夫向壽之於秦王，親也，少與之同衣，長與之同車，以聽事。
units.en: Xiang Shou is close to the King of Qin. In youth, he shared the same robes; in adulthood, the same chariot, attending to affairs together.
units.literal: Xiang Shou to Qin Wang, close, young with same clothes, long with same chariot, listen affairs.

units.zh: 王必相向壽於秦，則楚國之利也。」
units.en: If Your Majesty certainly makes Xiang Shou prime minister in Qin, it will benefit the state of Chu.'
units.literal: Wang certainly chancellor Xiang Shou Qin, then Chu state profit."

units.zh: 於是使使請秦相向壽於秦。
units.en: Therefore, they sent an envoy to request that Qin appoint Xiang Shou as prime minister.
units.literal: Then made envoy request Qin chancellor Xiang Shou Qin.

units.zh: 秦卒相向壽。
units.en: Qin ultimately appointed Xiang Shou as prime minister.
units.literal: Qin finally chancellor Xiang Shou.

units.zh: 而甘茂竟不得復入秦，卒於魏。
units.en: Gan Mao was ultimately unable to reenter Qin and died in Wei.
units.literal: Gan Mao finally not obtain reenter Qin, died Wei.

units.zh: 甘茂有孫曰甘羅。
units.en: Gan Mao had a grandson named Gan Luo.
units.literal: Gan Mao have grandson called Gan Luo.

units.zh: 甘羅者，甘茂孫也。
units.en: Gan Luo was Gan Mao's grandson.
units.literal: Gan Luo, Gan Mao grandson.

units.zh: 茂既死後，甘羅年十二，事秦相文信侯呂不韋。
units.en: After Gan Mao died, Gan Luo at age twelve served Qin's prime minister Wenxin Hou Lü Buwei.
units.literal: Mao died after, Gan Luo year twelve, served Qin chancellor Wen Xin Hou Lu Bu Wei.

units.zh: 秦始皇帝使剛成君蔡澤於燕，三年而燕王喜使太子丹入質於秦。
units.en: Qin Shi Huang sent Gangcheng Jun Cai Ze to Yan. After three years, King Xi of Yan sent Crown Prince Dan as hostage to Qin.
units.literal: Qin Shi Huang made Gang Cheng Jun Cai Ze Yan, three years Yan Wang Xi made crown prince Dan hostage Qin.

units.zh: 秦使張唐往相燕，欲與燕共伐趙以廣河閒之地。
units.en: Qin sent Zhang Tang to serve as prime minister of Yan, desiring to attack Zhao together with Yan to expand the Hejian territories.
units.literal: Qin made Zhang Tang go chancellor Yan, wished with Yan together attack Zhao broaden He Jian land.

units.zh: 張唐謂文信侯曰：「臣嘗為秦昭王伐趙，趙怨臣，曰：『得唐者與百里之地。』
units.en: Zhang Tang addressed Wenxin Hou: "Your subject once attacked Zhao for King Zhao of Qin. Zhao resents your subject and says: 'Whoever captures Tang will receive a hundred li of land.'
units.literal: Zhang Tang told Wen Xin Hou: "Subject once for Qin Zhao Wang attack Zhao, Zhao resent subject, said: 'Obtain Tang give hundred li land.'

units.zh: 今之燕必經趙，臣不可以行。」
units.en: To go to Yan now I must pass through Zhao—your subject cannot go."
units.literal: Now Yan must pass Zhao, subject cannot go."

units.zh: 文信侯不快，未有以彊也。
units.en: Wenxin Hou was displeased but had no way to compel him.
units.literal: Wen Xin Hou not happy, no with force.

units.zh: 甘羅曰：「君侯何不快之甚也？」
units.en: Gan Luo asked: 'Why is my lord so extremely displeased?'
units.literal: Gan Luo said: "Jun Hou why not happy very?"

units.zh: 文信侯曰：「吾令剛成君蔡澤事燕三年，燕太子丹已入質矣，吾自請張卿相燕而不肯行。」
units.en: Wenxin Hou declared: 'I had Gangcheng Jun Cai Ze serve Yan for three years, and Crown Prince Dan of Yan has already entered as hostage. I personally requested that Zhang Qing serve as prime minister of Yan, but he refuses to go.'
units.literal: Wen Xin Hou said: "I make Gang Cheng Jun Cai Ze serve Yan three years, Yan crown prince Dan already hostage Qin, I self please Zhang Qing chancellor Yan not willing go."

units.zh: 甘羅曰：「臣請行之。」
units.en: Gan Luo declared: 'Your subject requests to go.'
units.literal: Gan Luo said: "Subject please go."

units.zh: 文信侯叱曰：「去！
units.en: Wenxin Hou scolded: 'Away with you!
units.literal: Wen Xin Hou scolded: "Go!

units.zh: 我身自請之而不肯，女焉能行之？」
units.en: I personally requested it, and he refused—how can you accomplish it?'
units.literal: I body self please not willing, you how can go?"

units.zh: 甘羅曰：「大項橐生七歲為孔子師。
units.en: Gan Luo declared: 'The great Xiang Tuo became Confucius's teacher at age seven.
units.literal: Gan Luo said: "Da Xiang Tuo born seven years Confucius teacher.

units.zh: 今臣生十二歲於茲矣，君其試臣，何遽叱乎？」
units.en: Now your subject has lived twelve years here already. My lord should test your subject—why scold so hastily?'
units.literal: Now subject born twelve years here, jun its try subject, why hurry scold?"

units.zh: 於是甘羅見張卿曰：「卿之功孰與武安君？」
units.en: Then Gan Luo met Zhang Qing and asked: 'Whose merit compares with Lord Wu An's?'
units.literal: Then Gan Luo saw Zhang Qing: "Qing merit who with Wu An Jun?"

units.zh: 卿曰：「武安君南挫彊楚，北威燕、趙，戰勝攻取，破城墮邑，不知其數，臣之功不如也。」
units.en: Zhang Qing replied: 'Lord Wu An frustrated mighty Chu to the south and awed Yan and Zhao to the north. His battle victories, conquests, shattered cities, and fallen towns cannot be numbered—your subject's merit does not compare.'
units.literal: Qing said: "Wu An Jun south frustrate strong Chu, north awe Yan Zhao, battle victory attack take, break city fall cities, not know its number, subject merit not as."

units.zh: 甘羅曰：「應侯之用於秦也，孰與文信侯專？」
units.en: Gan Luo asked: 'How did Lord Ying's employment in Qin compare with Wenxin Hou's exclusive power?'
units.literal: Gan Luo said: "Ying Hou use Qin, who with Wen Xin Hou monopolize?"

units.zh: 張卿曰：「應侯不如文信侯專。」
units.en: Zhang Qing replied: 'Lord Ying's power was not as exclusive as Wenxin Hou's.'
units.literal: Zhang Qing said: "Ying Hou not as Wen Xin Hou monopolize."

units.zh: 甘羅曰：「卿明知其不如文信侯專與？」
units.en: Gan Luo asked: 'Do you clearly know that it did not equal Wenxin Hou's exclusive power?'
units.literal: Gan Luo said: "Qing bright know not as Wen Xin Hou monopolize?"

units.zh: 曰：「知之。」
units.en: He replied: 'I know it.'
units.literal: Said: "Know."

units.zh: 甘羅曰：「應侯欲攻趙，武安君難之，去咸陽七里而立死於杜郵。
units.en: Gan Luo declared: 'Lord Ying wished to attack Zhao, but Lord Wu'an objected. Seven li outside Xianyang, he was put to death at Duyou.
units.literal: Gan Luo said: "Ying Hou wish attack Zhao, Wu An Jun difficult it, leave Xian Yang seven li stand die Du You.

units.zh: 今文信侯自請卿相燕而不肯行，臣不知卿所死處矣。」
units.en: Now Wenxin Hou personally requests that you serve as prime minister of Yan, and you refuse to go. I do not know where you will die.'
units.literal: Now Wen Xin Hou self please Qing chancellor Yan not willing go, subject not know Qing die place."

units.zh: 張唐曰：「請因孺子行。」
units.en: Zhang Tang declared: 'I shall go because of this child.'
units.literal: Zhang Tang said: "Please because child go."

units.zh: 令裝治行。
units.en: They ordered preparations for the journey.
units.literal: Ordered prepare manage go.

units.zh: 行有日，甘羅謂文信侯曰：「借臣車五乘，請為張唐先報趙。」
units.en: When the day of departure arrived, Gan Luo addressed Wenxin Hou: 'Lend your subject five chariots. I wish to go ahead and report to Zhao for Zhang Tang.'
units.literal: Go have day, Gan Luo told Wen Xin Hou: "Borrow subject chariot five, please for Zhang Tang first report Zhao."

units.zh: 文信侯乃入言之於始皇曰：「昔甘茂之孫甘羅，年少耳，然名家之子孫，諸侯皆聞之。
units.en: Wenxin Hou then entered and spoke to Qin Shi Huang: 'Gan Mao's grandson Gan Luo is young indeed, yet he is the descendant of a famous family, and all the feudal lords have heard of him.
units.literal: Wen Xin Hou then entered spoke Shi Huang: "Former Gan Mao grandson Gan Luo, year young, yet famous family grandson, feudal lords all hear.

units.zh: 今者張唐欲稱疾不肯行，甘羅說而行之。
units.en: Now Zhang Tang wished to claim illness and refuse to go, but Gan Luo persuaded him and made him go.
units.literal: Now Zhang Tang wish claim ill not willing go, Gan Luo advise go.

units.zh: 今願先報趙，請許遣之。」
units.en: Now I wish to report to Zhao first—please permit me to be sent.'
units.literal: Now wish first report Zhao, please permit send."

units.zh: 始皇召見，使甘羅於趙。
units.en: Qin Shi Huang summoned him for an audience and dispatched Gan Luo to Zhao.
units.literal: Shi Huang summoned see, made Gan Luo Zhao.

units.zh: 趙襄王郊迎甘羅。
units.en: King Xiang of Zhao welcomed Gan Luo in the suburbs.
units.literal: Zhao Xiang Wang suburb welcomed Gan Luo.

units.zh: 甘羅說趙王曰：「王聞燕太子丹入質秦歟？」
units.en: Gan Luo advised the King of Zhao: 'Has Your Majesty heard that Yan's Crown Prince Dan has entered Qin as hostage?'
units.literal: Gan Luo advised Zhao Wang: "Wang hear Yan crown prince Dan hostage Qin?"

units.zh: 曰：「聞之。」
units.en: He replied: 'I have heard.'
units.literal: Said: "Hear."

units.zh: 曰：「聞張唐相燕歟？」
units.en: He asked: 'Have you heard that Zhang Tang serves as prime minister of Yan?'
units.literal: Said: "Hear Zhang Tang chancellor Yan?"

units.zh: 曰：「聞之。」
units.en: He replied: 'I have heard.'
units.literal: Said: "Hear."

units.zh: 「燕太子丹入秦者，燕不欺秦也。
units.en: 'Yan sending Crown Prince Dan as hostage to Qin shows that Yan is not deceiving Qin.
units.literal: Yan crown prince Dan hostage Qin, Yan not deceive Qin.

units.zh: 張唐相燕者，秦不欺燕也。
units.en: Qin sending Zhang Tang to serve as prime minister of Yan shows that Qin is not deceiving Yan.
units.literal: Zhang Tang chancellor Yan, Qin not deceive Yan.

units.zh: 燕、秦不相欺者，伐趙，危矣。
units.en: Since Yan and Qin are not deceiving each other, attacking Zhao would be dangerous.
units.literal: Yan Qin not deceive, attack Zhao, danger.

units.zh: 燕、秦不相欺無異故，欲攻趙而廣河閒。
units.en: Yan and Qin have no different motives in not deceiving each other—they both wish to attack Zhao and expand the Hejian territories.
units.literal: Yan Qin not deceive no different reason, wish attack Zhao broaden He Jian.

units.zh: 王不如齎臣五城以廣河閒，請歸燕太子，與彊趙攻弱燕。」
units.en: Your Majesty should grant your subject five cities to expand Hejian, request the return of Yan's crown prince, and attack weak Yan with strong Zhao.'
units.literal: Wang not as give subject five cities broaden He Jian, please return Yan crown prince, with strong Zhao attack weak Yan."

units.zh: 趙王立自割五城以廣河閒。
units.en: The King of Zhao immediately ceded five cities to expand Hejian.
units.literal: Zhao Wang immediately self divide five cities broaden He Jian.

units.zh: 秦歸燕太子。
units.en: Qin returned Yan's crown prince.
units.literal: Qin return Yan crown prince.

units.zh: 趙攻燕，得上谷三十城，令秦有十一。
units.en: Zhao attacked Yan, captured thirty cities in Shanggu, and ceded eleven to Qin.
units.literal: Zhao attack Yan, obtain Shang Gu thirty cities, make Qin have eleven.

units.zh: 甘羅還報秦，乃封甘羅以為上卿，復以始甘茂田宅賜之。
units.en: Gan Luo returned and reported to Qin, who then enfeoffed him as upper minister and restored Gan Mao's original fields and residence to him.
units.literal: Gan Luo returned and reported to Qin, which appointed him an upper minister and restored to him the fields and residence that had formerly belonged to Gan Mao.

units.zh: 太史公曰：樗里子以骨肉重，固其理，而秦人稱其智，故頗采焉。
units.en: The Grand Historian remarks: Shu Lizi was honored for his kinship ties, which was only natural, yet the people of Qin praised his wisdom, therefore I have collected much about him.
units.literal: Grand Historian said: Shu Lizi with bone flesh heavy, solid its reason, Qin people praise his wisdom, therefore much collect.

units.zh: 甘茂起下蔡閭閻，顯名諸侯，重彊齊楚。
units.en: Gan Mao rose from humble alleys and doorways in Xiaca, made his name manifest among the feudal lords, and was esteemed by mighty Qi and Chu.
units.literal: Gan Mao rise Xia Cai alley door, manifest name feudal lords, heavy strong Qi Chu.

units.zh: 甘羅年少，然出一奇計，聲稱後世。
units.en: Gan Luo was young, yet he produced a remarkable strategy that will be proclaimed famous in later generations.
units.literal: Gan Luo year young, yet put out strange plan, sound proclaim later generations.

units.zh: 雖非篤行之君子，然亦戰國之策士也。
units.en: Though not a gentleman of solid virtue, he was nevertheless a strategist of the Warring States period.
units.literal: Though not solid conduct gentleman, yet also Warring States strategists.

units.zh: 方秦之彊時，天下尤趨謀詐哉。
units.en: When Qin was at the height of its strength, did not the world especially incline toward plotting and deceit?
units.literal: When Qin strong time, world especially incline plot deceit.
